title: SmolVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model trained on Lerobot Community Data
quote: SmolVLA goes through a pretraining phase on general manipulation data, followed by task-specific post-training.
quote2: we curated a collection of 487 high-quality datasets focused on the SO100 robotic arm
quote3: Small enough to run on CPU, train on a single consumer GPU, or even a MacBook!
paper: arXiv 2506.01844, SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics (2 Jun 2025)
